summary: Completed comprehensive testing of KaalChakra V3 gallery, map, and per-fort 3D models features. All 32 backend API tests passed (100% success rate). All V3 frontend features tested and working: Home feature cards are clickable links, Explore page shows interactive Leaflet map with 6 fort markers, Fort Detail page has swipeable photo gallery with multiple Wikimedia images, and distinct CC0 3D models load per fort. Mobile responsive with no horizontal overflow. V1 and V2 regression tests passed.
